header: Two states of one subject under a single heading
lead: The band takes the first two files and gives each its own caption from the file's own metadata. Side by side is the default; the reveal variant stacks them and slides a boundary across.

images.alternative: The bakery shopfront before the refit: faded paintwork and a sagging awning
images.title: Before — March

images.alternative: The same shopfront after the refit: repainted, with a new awning and clear glazing
images.title: After — September

caption: Each picture takes its caption from the file's own title.
note: The reveal sits at the halfway line at rest, so both states are visible before anybody hovers. It falls back to two stacked pictures wherever the wipe cannot be drawn.
